decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the firm's core knowledge and, having disappeared from view after 2019, is very likely to have been or soon be abandoned so resources can return to areas where the firm can learn and improve faster.

Although medical examination lighting builds on lighting expertise, its more specialised medical application lies outside the firm's main commercial-industrial base and its absence after the launch period suggests limited enough traction to justify withdrawal.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's capabilities well, but the product's non-observation after 2019 indicates that as a distinct line it has likely been rationalised or is likely to be taken off within the year.

The designer task light was close to the established offer, but its disappearance after the relaunch points to a short product cycle or portfolio consolidation, making discontinuation the more likely management choice now.
A pendant office luminaire is close to the firm's core building-lighting knowledge, so a large R&D-active German lighting producer would usually keep it and refine it rather than exit quickly.

A premium pendant luminaire line with several models draws directly on the firm's established design, engineering and LED capabilities, giving management good absorptive capacity to improve and sustain it.
